subject.title: fix: serialize outbound deliveries per channel+recipient

question: Should maintainers sponsor a current-main replacement/repair for this proof-positive draft PR, or wait for the contributor to rework the conflicting branch?
rationale: The bug and proof are strong, but the branch is draft, merge-conflicting, and needs non-trivial owner-boundary repair rather than a routine exact-head merge.

options.title: Sponsor a current-main repair

options.title: Decline the branch
